resolution.note: ownerCheckout maps a removed .krn/worktrees/<name> to its main checkout; runTests returns <run>::error on spawn failure; test/hook/stop.test.ts removed-worktree case red before, green after

title: Stop judges a lane whose worktree ship removed at its main checkout
body:
Outcome: the Stop hook judges a krn-lane subagent whose worktree `krn pr ship` removed at the main checkout that owned it, and a test run that cannot spawn fails as one run instead of crashing on undefined stdout.
Why: lane t-vs35jd7 merged #1137 (6b35f9f); its worktree was pruned and Stop crashed at src/hook/stop.ts runTests (run.stdout undefined).
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts: pass with the removed-worktree case.
